device_entry.name: SYSTEC UCAN CAN 通信组件
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
CAN总线通信记录与离线分析
device_entry.description: 用于通过 SYSTEC UCAN 接口接收和读取 CAN 总线消息的非物理通信组件。它通常用于实验系统中连接基于 CAN 的仪器或控制节点，并提供基于事件和超时的消息读取能力。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical communication component for receiving and reading CAN bus messages through a SYSTEC UCAN interface. It is typically used in laboratory systems to connect CAN-based instruments or control nodes, providing event-driven and timeout-based message reading.

schema.description: 处理指定通道收到 CAN 消息的事件。
schema.description_en: Handle the event indicating that a CAN message was received on the specified channel.

schema.description: 在指定通道上按超时读取一定数量的 CAN 消息。
schema.description_en: Read a specified number of CAN messages from the selected channel with a timeout.
